# One embedding per entity and model

Embeddings use a composite primary key (entity_id, model_id), so at most one embedding row exists per (entity, model) pair.

Associate a single semantic vector per entity for each embedding model generation.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/storage/schema.py` — `knowledge_compiler.storage.schema.EmbeddingRow`
